name: Meidi! ~Goshujin-sama wa Doukyuusei~
original_name: メイでぃ！～ご主人様は同級生～
source:
Hajime is a crooked student from a rich family. His parents died when he was a child, and he took over their business. He acts like a good boy at school but is bored to death.

One day, another company that borrowed money from his goes bankrupt and the president's three daughters, Kazumi, Futaba and Miyo, come to his house to work as maids. They gradually loosen up and...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
始是一名出身富裕家庭、性格乖僻的学生。他的父母在他小时候便已去世，家族生意也由他接手。他在学校里装成乖学生，心里却无聊透顶。

一天，另一家公司因欠下始名下公司的债务而破产。社长的三个女儿——和美、双叶与美代——来到他家担任女仆。她们渐渐放下戒心，而后…
